pli-tv-kd22:1.1.1: paṭhama bhāṇavāraṃ tena kho pana samayena vassasataparinibbute bhagavati vesālikāvajjiputtakā bhikkhū vesāliyaṃ dasavatthuni dīpenti:
pli-tv-kd22:1.1.2: kappati siṅgiloṇakappo. kappati dvaṅgulakappo. kappati gāmantarakappo. kappati āvāsakappo. kappati anumatikappo. kappati āciṇṇakappo. kappati amathitakappo. kappati jalogipātuṃ, kappati adasakaṃ nisīdanaṃ. kappati jātarūparajatanti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.1.3: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā yaso kākaṇḍakaputto vajjīsu cārikaṃ caramāno yena vesālī tadavasari.
pli-tv-kd22:1.1.4: tatra sudaṃ āyasmā yaso kākaṇḍakaputto vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
pli-tv-kd22:1.1.5: tena kho pana samayena vesālikā vajjiputtakā bhikkhū tadahuposathe kaṃsapātiṃ udakena pūretvā majjhe bhikkhusaṅghassa ṭhapetvā āgatāgate vesālike upāsake evaṃ vadenti:
pli-tv-kd22:1.1.6: dethāvuso saṅghassa kahāpaṇampi aḍḍhampi pādampi māsakarūpampi.
pli-tv-kd22:1.1.8: evaṃ vutte āyasmā yaso kākaṇḍakaputto vesālike upāsake etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd22:1.1.9: māvuso adattha saṅghassa kahāpaṇampi aḍḍhampi pādampi māsakarūpampi.
pli-tv-kd22:1.1.14: evampi kho vesālikā upāsakā āyasmatā yasena kākaṇḍakaputtena vuccamānā adaṃsu yeva saṅghassa kahāpaṇampi aḍḍhampi pādampi māsakarūpampi.
pli-tv-kd22:1.1.15: atha kho vesālikā vajjiputtakā bhikkhū tassā rattiyā accayena taṃ hiraññaṃ bhikkhaggena paṭiviṃsaṃ ṭhapetvā bhājesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd22:1.1.16: atha kho vesālikā vajjiputtakā bhikkhū āyasmantaṃ yasaṃ kākaṇḍakaputtaṃ etadavocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd22:1.1.17: eso te āvuso yasa hiraññassa paṭiviṃsoti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.1.18: natthi me āvuso hiraññassa paṭiviṃso nāhaṃ hiraññaṃ sādiyāmīti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.2.2: ayaṃ āvuso yaso kākaṇḍakaputto upāsake saddhe pasanne akkosati, paribhāsati, appasādaṃ karoti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.2.3: handassa mayaṃ paṭisāraṇīyakammaṃ karomāti, te tassa paṭisāraṇīyakammaṃ akaṃsu.
pli-tv-kd22:1.2.4: atha kho āyasmā yaso kākaṇḍakaputto vesālike vajjiputtake bhikkhū etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd22:1.2.8: atha kho vesālikā vajjiputtakā bhikkhū ekaṃ bhikkhuṃ sammannitvā āyasmato yasassa kākaṇḍakaputtassa anudūtaṃ adaṃsu.
pli-tv-kd22:1.2.9: atha kho āyasmā yaso kākaṇḍakaputto anudūtena bhikkhunā saddhiṃ vesāliṃ pavisitvā vesālike upāsake etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd22:1.2.10: ahaṃ kirāyasmante upāsake saddhe pasanne akkosāmi, paribhāsāmi, appasādaṃ karomi.
pli-tv-kd22:1.2.11: sohaṃ adhammaṃ adhammoti vadāmi. dhammaṃ dhammoti vadāmi. avinayaṃ avinayoti vadāmi. vinayaṃ vinayoti vadāmi.
pli-tv-kd22:1.3.1: ekamidaṃ āvuso samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-kd22:1.3.2: tatra kho āvuso bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd22:1.3.3: cattāro me bhikkhave candimasuriyānaṃ upakkilesā yehi upakkilesehi upakkiliṭṭhā candimasūriyā na tapanti na bhāsanti na virocanti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.3.4: katame cattāro? abbhaṃ bhikkhave candimasuriyānaṃ upakkileso yena upakkilesena upakkiliṭṭhā candimasūriyā na tapanti na bhāsanti na virocanti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.3.8: yehi upakkilesehi upakkiliṭṭhā candimasūriyā na tapanti na bhāsanti na virocanti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.3.9: evameva kho bhikkhave cattārome samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ upakkilesāyehi upakkilesehi upakkiliṭṭhā eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā na tapanti na bhāsanti na virocanti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.3.11: santi bhikkhave eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā suraṃ pivanti. merayaṃ pivanti. surāmerayapānā appaṭiviratā.
pli-tv-kd22:1.3.12: ayaṃ bhikkhave paṭhamo samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ upakkileso yena upakkilesena upakkiliṭṭhā eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā na tapanti. na bhāsanti. na virocanti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.3.13: puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā methunaṃ dhammaṃ patisevanti, methunadhammā appaṭiviratā.
pli-tv-kd22:1.3.15: puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā jātarūparajataṃ sādiyanti jātarūparajatapaṭiggahaṇā appaṭiviratā.
pli-tv-kd22:1.3.17: puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā micchājīvena jīvitaṃ kappenti
pli-tv-kd22:1.3.20: ime kho bhikkhave cattāro samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ upakkilesā yehi upakkilesehi upakkiliṭṭhā eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā na tapanti na bhāsanti na virocantīti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.3.22: idaṃ vatvāna sugato athāparaṃ etadavoca satthā:
pli-tv-kd22:1.3.37: na tapanti na bhāsanti na virocanti
pli-tv-kd22:1.3.43: evaṃvādī kirāhaṃ āyasmante upāsake saddhe pasanne akkosāmi, paribhāsāmi, appasādaṃ karomi.
pli-tv-kd22:1.3.44: sohaṃ adhammaṃ adhammoti vadāmi. dhammaṃ dhammoti vadāmi. avinayaṃ avinayoti vadāmi. vinayaṃ vinayoti vadāmi.
pli-tv-kd22:1.4.1: ekamidaṃ āvuso samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
pli-tv-kd22:1.4.2: tena kho panāvuso samayena rājantepure rājaparisāyaṃ sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ ayamantarā kathā udapādi:
pli-tv-kd22:1.4.6: tena kho panāvuso samayena maṇicūḷako gāmaṇī tassaṃ parisāyaṃ nisinno hoti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.4.7: atha kho āvuso maṇicūḷako gāmaṇī taṃ parisaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd22:1.4.13: asakkhi kho āvuso maṇicūḷako gāmaṇī taṃ parisaṃ saññāpetuṃ.
pli-tv-kd22:1.4.14: atha kho āvuso maṇicūḷako gāmaṇī taṃ parisaṃ saññāpetvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd22:1.4.15: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āvuso maṇicūḷako gāmaṇī bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd22:1.4.16: idha bhante rājantepure rājaparisāyaṃ sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ ayamantarā kathā udapādi:
pli-tv-kd22:1.4.20: evaṃ vutte ahaṃ bhante taṃ parisaṃ etadavocaṃ:
pli-tv-kd22:1.4.26: asakkhiṃ kho ahaṃ bhante taṃ parisaṃ saññāpetuṃ.
pli-tv-kd22:1.4.27: kaccāhaṃ bhante evaṃ vyākaramāno vuttavādī ceva bhagavato homi. na ca bhagavantaṃ abhūtena abbhācikkhāmi. dhammassa cānudhammaṃ vyākaromi. na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānuvādo gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgacchatīti?
pli-tv-kd22:1.4.28: taggha tvaṃ gāmaṇi evaṃ vyākaramāno vuttavādī ceva me ahosi
pli-tv-kd22:1.4.29: na ca maṃ abhūtena abbhācikkhasi. dhammassa cānudhammaṃ vyākarosi. na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānuvādo gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgacchati.
pli-tv-kd22:1.4.30: na hi gāmaṇi kappati samaṇānaṃ sakyaputtiyānaṃ jātarūparajataṃ.
pli-tv-kd22:1.4.34: yassa kho gāmaṇi jātarūparajataṃ kappati, pañcapi tassa kāmaguṇā kappanti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.4.35: yassa pañca kāmaguṇā kappanti, ekaṃsenetaṃ gāmaṇi dhāreyyāsi
pli-tv-kd22:1.4.37: apicāhaṃ gāmaṇi evaṃ vadāmi: tiṇaṃ tiṇatthikena pariyesitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd22:1.4.41: natvevāhaṃ gāmaṇi kenaci pariyāyena jātarūparajataṃ sāditabbaṃ pariyesitabbanti vadāmīti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.4.42: evaṃvādī kirāhaṃ āyasmante upāsake saddhe pasanne akkosāmi paribhāsāmi appasādaṃ karomi.
pli-tv-kd22:1.4.43: sohaṃ adhammaṃ adhammoti vadāmi. dhammaṃ dhammoti vadāmi. avinayaṃ avinayoti vadāmi. vinayaṃ vinayoti vadāmi.
pli-tv-kd22:1.5.1: ekamidaṃ āvuso samayaṃ bhagavā tattheva rājagahe āyasmantaṃ upanandaṃ sakyaputtaṃ ārabbha jātarūparajataṃ paṭikkhipi sikkhāpadaṃ ca paññāpesi.
pli-tv-kd22:1.5.2: evaṃvādī kirāhaṃ āyasmante upāsake saddhe pasanne akkosāmi, paribhāsāmi, appasādaṃ karomi
pli-tv-kd22:1.5.3: sohaṃ adhammaṃ adhammoti vadāmi. dhammaṃ dhammoti vadāmi. avinayaṃ avinayoti vadāmi. vinayaṃ vinayoti vadāmīti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.6.1: evaṃ vutte vesālikā upāsakā āyasmantaṃ yasaṃ kākaṇḍakaputtaṃ etadavocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd22:1.6.2: ekova bhante ayyo yaso kākaṇḍakaputto samaṇo sakyaputtiyo.
pli-tv-kd22:1.6.4: vasatu bhante ayyo yaso kākaṇḍakaputto vesāliyaṃ.
pli-tv-kd22:1.6.5: mayaṃ ayyassa yasassa kākaṇḍakaputtassa ussukkaṃ karissāma cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārānanti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.6.6: atha kho āyasmā yaso kākaṇḍakaputto vesālike upāsake saññāpetvā anudūtena bhikkhunā saddhiṃ ārāmaṃ agamāsi.
pli-tv-kd22:1.7.1: atha kho vesālikā vajjiputtakā bhikkhū anudūtaṃ bhikkhuṃ pucchiṃsu:
pli-tv-kd22:1.7.2: khamāpitā āvuso yasena kākaṇḍakaputtena vesālikā upāsakāti?
pli-tv-kd22:1.7.4: ekova yaso kākaṇḍakaputto samaṇo sakyaputtiyo kato.
pli-tv-kd22:1.7.7: ayaṃ āvuso yaso kākaṇḍakaputto amhehi asammato gihīnaṃ pakāsesi.
pli-tv-kd22:1.7.10: atha kho āyasmā yaso kākaṇḍakaputto vehāsaṃ abbhuggantvā kosambiyaṃ paccuṭṭhāsi.
pli-tv-kd22:1.7.11.1: atha kho āyasmā yaso kākaṇḍakaputto pāveyyakānañca avantidakkhiṇāpathakānañca bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ pāhesi:
pli-tv-kd22:1.7.16: pure adhammavādino balavanto honti dhammavādino dubbalā honti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.7.17: avinayavādino balavanto honti vinayavādino dubbalā hontīti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.8.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā sambhūto sāṇavāsī ahogaṅge pabbate paṭivasati.
pli-tv-kd22:1.8.2: atha kho āyasmā yaso kākaṇḍakaputto yena ahogaṅgo pabbato yenāyasmā sambhūto sāṇavāsī tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ sambhūtaṃ sāṇavāsiṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd22:1.8.3: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā yaso kākaṇḍakaputto āyasmantaṃ sambhūtaṃ sāṇavāsiṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd22:1.8.4: ime bhante vesālikā vajjiputtakā bhikkhū vesāliyaṃ dasavatthūni dīpenti-
pli-tv-kd22:1.8.5: kappati siṅgiloṇakappo. kappati dvaṅgulakappo. kappati gāmantarakappo. kappati āvāsakappo. kappati anumatikappo. kappati āciṇṇakappo. kappati amathitakappo. kappati jalogipātuṃ. kappati adasakaṃ nisīdanaṃ. kappati jātarūparajatanti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.8.6: handa mayaṃ bhante imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ ādiyissāma.
pli-tv-kd22:1.8.9: pure adhammavādino balavanto honti dhammavādino dubbalā honti
pli-tv-kd22:1.8.10: avinayavādino balavanto honti vinayavādino dubbalā hontīti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.8.11: evamāvusoti kho āyasmā sambhūto sāṇavāsī āyasmato yasassa kākaṇḍakaputtassa paccassosi.
pli-tv-kd22:1.8.13: sabbe āraññikā, sabbe piṇḍapātikā, sabbe paṃsukūlikā, sabbe tecīvarikā, sabbeva arahanto
pli-tv-kd22:1.8.16: appekacce āraññikā, appekacce piṇḍapātikā, appekacce paṃsukūlikā, appekacce tecīvarikā sabbeva arahanto
pli-tv-kd22:1.9.1: atha kho therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ mantayamānānaṃ etadahosi:
pli-tv-kd22:1.9.3: kaṃ nu kho mayaṃ pakkhaṃ labheyyāma yena mayaṃ imasmiṃ adhikaraṇe balavantatarā assāmāti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.9.4: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā revato soreyye paṭivasati
pli-tv-kd22:1.9.5: bahussuto āgatāgamo dhammadharo vinayadharo mātikādharo paṇḍito vyatto medhāvī lajjī kukkuccako sikkhākāmo.
pli-tv-kd22:1.9.8: bahussuto āgatāgamo dhammadharo vinayadharo mātikādharo paṇḍito vyatto medhāvī lajjī kukkuccako sikkhākāmo.
pli-tv-kd22:1.9.9: sace mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ revataṃ pakkhaṃ labhissāma evaṃ mayaṃ imasmiṃ adhikaraṇe balavantatarā assāmāti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.9.15: na kho metaṃ patirūpaṃ sohaṃ evarūpe adhikaraṇe osakkeyyaṃ.
pli-tv-kd22:1.9.16: idāni ca pana te bhikkhū āgacchissanti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.9.17: sohaṃ tehi ākiṇṇo na phāsuṃ gamissāmi.
pli-tv-kd22:1.9.19: atha kho āyasmā revato soreyyā saṅkassaṃ agamāsi.
pli-tv-kd22:1.9.20: atha kho therā bhikkhū soreyyaṃ gantvā pucchiṃsu
pli-tv-kd22:1.9.24: atha kho āyasmā revato saṅkassā kaṇṇakujjaṃ agamāsi.
pli-tv-kd22:1.9.25: atha kho therā bhikkhū saṅkassaṃ gantvā pucchiṃsu
pli-tv-kd22:1.9.29: atha kho āyasmā revato kaṇṇakujjā udumbaraṃ agamāsi.
pli-tv-kd22:1.9.30: atha kho therā bhikkhū kaṇṇakujjaṃ gantvā pucchiṃsu
pli-tv-kd22:1.9.34: atha kho āyasmā revato udumbarā aggaḷapuraṃ agamāsi.
pli-tv-kd22:1.9.35: atha kho therā bhikkhū udumbaraṃ gantvā pucchiṃsu
pli-tv-kd22:1.9.39: atha kho āyasmā revato aggaḷapurā sahajātiṃ agamāsi.
pli-tv-kd22:1.9.40: atha kho therā bhikkhū aggaḷapuraṃ gantvā pucchiṃsu
pli-tv-kd22:1.9.44: atha kho therā bhikkhū āyasmantaṃ revataṃ sahajātiyā sambhāvesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd22:1.10.1: atha kho āyasmā sambhūto sāṇavāsī āyasmantaṃ yasaṃ kākaṇḍakaputtaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd22:1.10.2: ayaṃ āvuso āyasmā revato bahussuto āgatāgamo dhammadharo vinayadharo mātikādharo paṇḍito vyatto medhāvī lajjī kukkuccako sikkhākāmo
pli-tv-kd22:1.10.3: sace mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ revataṃ pañhaṃ pucchissāma paṭibalo āyasmā revato ekeneva pañhena sakalampi rattiṃ vītināmetuṃ.
pli-tv-kd22:1.10.4: idāni ca panāyasmā revato antevāsikaṃ sarabhāṇakaṃ bhikkhuṃ ajjhesissati.
pli-tv-kd22:1.10.5: so tvaṃ tassa bhikkhuno sarabhaññapariyosāne āyasmantaṃ revataṃ upasaṅkamitvā imāni dasavatthūni puccheyyāsīti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.10.6: evambhanteti kho āyasmā yaso kākaṇḍakaputto āyasmato sambhūtassa sāṇavāsissa paccassosi.
pli-tv-kd22:1.10.7: atha kho āyasmā revato antevāsikaṃ sarabhāṇakaṃ bhikkhuṃ ajjhesi.
pli-tv-kd22:1.10.8: atha kho āyasmā yaso kākaṇḍakaputto tassa bhikkhuno sarabhaññapariyosāne yenāyasmā revato tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ revataṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd22:1.10.9: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā yaso kākaṇḍakaputto āyasmantaṃ revataṃ etadavoca: 12.1.
pli-tv-kd22:1.10.17: kappati bhante dvaṅgulāya chāyāya vītivattāya vikāle bhojanaṃ bhuñjitunti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.10.21: kappati bhante idāni gāmantaraṃ gamissāmīti bhuttāvinā pavāritena anatirittaṃ bhojanaṃ bhuñjitunti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.10.25: kappati bhante sambahulā āvāsā samānasīmā nānuposathaṃ kātunti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.10.29: kappati bhante vaggena saṅghena kammaṃ kātuṃ
pli-tv-kd22:1.10.34: kappati bhante idaṃ me upajjhāyena ajjhāciṇṇaṃ idaṃ me ācariyena ajjhāciṇṇanti taṃ ajjhācaritunti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.10.35: āciṇṇakappo kho āvuso ekacco kappati ekacco na kappatīti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.10.38: kappati bhante yaṃ taṃ khīraṃ khīrabhāvaṃ vijahitaṃ asampattaṃ dadhibhāvaṃ taṃ bhuttāvinā pavāritena anatirittaṃ pātunti,
pli-tv-kd22:1.10.42: kappati bhante yā sā surā asuttā asampattā majjabhāvaṃ. taṃ pātunti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.10.48: ime bhante vesālikā vajjiputtakā bhikkhū vesāliyaṃ imāni dasavatthūni dīpenti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.10.49: handa mayaṃ bhante imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ ādiyāma.
pli-tv-kd22:1.10.52: pure adhammavādino balavanto honti dhammavādino dubbalā honti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.10.53: avinayavādino balavanto honti. vinayavādino dubbalā hontīti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.10.54: evamāvusoti kho āyasmā revato āyasmato yasassa kākaṇḍakaputtassa paccassosi.
pli-tv-kd22:2.1.2: yaso kira kākaṇḍakaputto imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ ādiyitukāmo pakkhaṃ pariyesati. labhati ca kira pakkhanti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.1.3: atha kho vesālikānaṃ vajjiputtakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ etadahosi:
pli-tv-kd22:2.1.5: kannu kho mayaṃ pakkhaṃ labheyyāma yena mayaṃ imasmiṃ adhikaraṇe balavantatarā assāmāti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.1.6: atha kho vesālikānaṃ vajjiputtakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ etadahosi:
pli-tv-kd22:2.1.7: ayaṃ kho āyasmā revato bahussuto āgatāgamo dhammadharo vinayadharo mātikādharo paṇḍito vyatto medhāvī lajjī kukkuccako sikkhākāmo.
pli-tv-kd22:2.1.8: sace mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ revataṃ pakkhaṃ labheyyāma evaṃ mayaṃ imasmiṃ adhikaraṇe balavantatarā assāmāti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.1.9: atha kho vesālikā vajjiputtakā bhikkhū pahūtaṃ sāmaṇakaṃ parikkhāraṃ paṭiyādesuṃ
pli-tv-kd22:2.1.10: pattampi cīvarampi nisīdanampi sūcigharampi kāyabandhanampi parissāvanampi dhammakaraṇampi.
pli-tv-kd22:2.1.11: atha kho vesālikā vajjiputtakā bhikkhū taṃ sāmaṇakaṃ parikkhāraṃ ādāya nāvāya sahajātiṃ ujjaviṃsu.
pli-tv-kd22:2.1.12: nāvāya paccorohitvā aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle bhattavissaggaṃ karonti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.2.1: atha kho āyasmato sāḷhassa rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi.
pli-tv-kd22:2.2.4: atha kho āyasmato sāḷhassa dhammañca vinayañca cetasā paccavekkhantassa etadahosi:
pli-tv-kd22:2.2.5: adhammavādino pācīnakā bhikkhū dhammavādino pāveyyakā bhikkhūti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.2.6: atha kho aññatarā suddhāvāsakāyikā devatā āyasmato sāḷhassa cetasā ceto parivitakkamaññāya
pli-tv-kd22:2.2.7: seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya evameva suddhāvāsesu devesu antarahitā āyasmato sāḷhassa pamukhe pāturahosi.
pli-tv-kd22:2.2.8: atha kho sā devatā āyasmantaṃ sāḷhaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd22:2.2.9: sādhu sādhu bhante sāḷha, adhammavādino pācīnakā bhikkhū dhammavādino pāveyyakā bhikkhū.
pli-tv-kd22:2.2.10: tena hi bhante sāḷha, yathā dhammo tathā tiṭṭhāhīti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.2.11: pubbepi cāhaṃ devate etarahi ca yathā dhammo tathā ṭhito.
pli-tv-kd22:2.2.12: api cāhaṃ na tāva diṭṭhiṃ āvīkaromi. appevanāma maṃ imasmiṃ adhikaraṇe sammanneyyāti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.3.1: atha kho vesālikā vajjiputtakā bhikkhū taṃ sāmaṇakaṃ parikkhāraṃ ādāya yenāyasmā revato tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ revataṃ etadavocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd22:2.3.3: pattampi cīvarampi nisīdanampi sūcigharampi kāyabandhanampi parissāvanampi dhammakaraṇampīti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.3.4: alaṃ āvuso, paripuṇṇaṃ me pattacīvaranti na icchi paṭiggahetuṃ.
pli-tv-kd22:2.3.5: tena kho pana samayena uttaro nāma bhikkhu vīsati vasso āyasmato revatassa upaṭṭhāko hoti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.3.6: atha kho vesālikā vajjiputtakā bhikkhū yenāyasmā uttaro tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ uttaraṃ etadavocuṃ
pli-tv-kd22:2.3.8: pattampi cīvarampi nisīdanampi sūcigharampi kāyabandhanampi parissāvanampi dhammakarakampīti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.3.9: alaṃ āvuso paripuṇṇaṃ me pattacīvaranti. na icchi paṭiggahetuṃ.
pli-tv-kd22:2.3.10: manussā kho āvuso uttara, bhagavato sāmaṇakaṃ parikkhāraṃ upanāmenti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.3.11: sace bhagavā paṭigaṇhāti teneva te attamanā honti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.3.12: no ce bhagavā paṭigaṇhāti āyasmato ānandassa upanāmenti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.3.14: yathā bhagavatā paṭiggahito evameva so bhavissatīti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.3.16: yathā therena paṭiggahito evameva so bhavissatīti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.3.17: atha kho āyasmā uttaro vesālikehi vajjiputtakehi bhikkhūhi nippīḷiyamāno ekaṃ cīvaraṃ aggahesi.
pli-tv-kd22:2.3.22: dhammavādino pācīnakā bhikkhū adhammavādino pāveyyakā bhikkhūti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.3.24: kho āyasmā uttaro vesālikānaṃ vajjiputtakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ paṭissutvā yenāyasmā revato tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ revataṃ etadavoca
pli-tv-kd22:2.3.27: dhammavādino pācīnakā bhikkhū adhammavādino pāveyyakā bhikkhūti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.3.28: adhamme maṃ tvaṃ bhikkhu niyojesīti thero āyasmantaṃ uttaraṃ paṇāmesi.
pli-tv-kd22:2.3.29: atha kho vesālikā vajjiputtakā bhikkhū āyasmantaṃ uttaraṃ etadavocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd22:2.3.32: adhamme maṃ tvaṃ bhikkhu niyojesīti thero maṃ paṇāmesīti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.3.34: āmāvusoti. api ca mayaṃ garunissayaṃ gaṇhāmāti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.4.1: atha kho saṅgho taṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vinicchinitukāmo sannipati.
pli-tv-kd22:2.4.2: atha kho āyasmā revato saṅghaṃ ñāpesi:
pli-tv-kd22:2.4.4: sace mayaṃ imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ idha vūpasameyyāma siyāpi mūlādāyakā bhikkhū punakammāya ukkoṭeyyuṃ.
pli-tv-kd22:2.4.5: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ yatthevimaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ samuppannaṃ. saṅgho tatthevimaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasameyyāti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.4.6: atha kho therā bhikkhū vesāliṃ agamaṃsu
pli-tv-kd22:2.4.8: tena kho pana samayena sabbakāmī nāma pathavyā saṅghatthero vīsavassasatiko upasampadāya āyasmato ānandassa saddhivihāriko vesāliyaṃ paṭivasati.
pli-tv-kd22:2.4.9: atha kho āyasmā revato āyasmantaṃ sambhūtaṃ sāṇavāsiṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd22:2.4.10: ahaṃ āvuso yasmiṃ vihāre sabbakāmī thero viharati taṃ vihāraṃ upagacchāmi.
pli-tv-kd22:2.4.11: so tvaṃ kālasseva āyasmantaṃ sabbakāmiṃ upasaṅkamitvā imāni dasavatthūni puccheyyāsīti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.4.12: evambhanteti kho āyasmā sambhūto sāṇavāsī āyasmato revatassa paccassosi.
pli-tv-kd22:2.4.13: atha kho āyasmā revato yasmiṃ vihāre sabbakāmī thero viharati taṃ vihāraṃ upagañchi.
pli-tv-kd22:2.4.14: gabbhe āyasmato sabbakāmissa senāsanaṃ paññattaṃ hoti, gabbha pamukhe āyasmato revatassa.
pli-tv-kd22:2.4.19: ayaṃ bhikkhu āgantuko kilanto na nipajjatīti
pli-tv-kd22:2.5.1: atha kho āyasmā sabbakāmī rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya āyasmantaṃ revataṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd22:2.5.2: katamena tvaṃ bhummi vihārena etarahi bahulaṃ viharasīti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.5.3: mettāvihārena kho ahaṃ bhante etarahi bahulaṃ viharāmīti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.5.4: kullakavihārena kira tvaṃ bhummi etarahi bahulaṃ viharasi’
pli-tv-kd22:2.5.6: pubbepi me bhante gihībhūtassa āciṇṇā mettā.
pli-tv-kd22:2.5.7: tenāhaṃ etarahipi mettāvihārena bahulaṃ viharāmi. api ca kho mayā cirappattaṃ arahattaṃ.
pli-tv-kd22:2.5.8: thero pana bhante katamena vihārena etarahi bahulaṃ viharatīti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.5.9: suññatā vihārena kho ahaṃ bhummi etarahi bahulaṃ viharāmīti?
pli-tv-kd22:2.5.10: mahāpurisavihārena kira bhante thero etarahi bahulaṃ viharati.
pli-tv-kd22:2.5.12: pubbepi me bhūmi gihībhūtassa āciṇṇā suññatā.
pli-tv-kd22:2.5.13: tenāhaṃ etarahipi suññatāvihārena bahulaṃ viharāmi. api ca mayā cirapattaṃ arahattanti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.6.1: ayañcarahi therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ antarā kathā vippakatā. athāyasmā sambhūto sāṇavāsī tasmiṃ anuppatto hoti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.6.2: atha kho āyasmā sambhūto sāṇavāsī yenāyasmā sabbakāmī tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ sabbakāmiṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd22:2.6.3: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā sambhūto sāṇavāsī āyasmantaṃ sabbakāmiṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd22:2.6.4: ime bhante vesālikā vajjiputtakā bhikkhū vesāliyaṃ dasavatthūni dīpenti:
pli-tv-kd22:2.6.5: kappati siṅgiloṇa kappo. kappati dvaṅgulakappo. kappati gāmantarakappo. kappati āvāsakappo. kappati anumatikappo. kappati āciṇṇakappo. kappati amathitakappo. kappati jalogi pātuṃ. kappati adasakaṃ nisīdanaṃ. kappati jātarūparajatanti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.6.6: therena bhante upajjhāyassa mūle bahudhammo ca vinayo ca pariyatto.
pli-tv-kd22:2.6.7: therassa bhante dhammañca vinayañca paccavekkhantassa kathaṃ hoti
pli-tv-kd22:2.6.10: tayāpi kho āvuso upajjhāyassa mūle bahu dhammo ca vinayo ca pariyatto.
pli-tv-kd22:2.6.11: tuyhaṃ panāvuso dhammañca vinayañca paccavekkhantassa kathaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.6.14: mayhaṃ kho bhante dhammañca vinayañca paccavekkhantassa evaṃ hoti:
pli-tv-kd22:2.6.15: adhammavādī pācīnakā bhikkhū dhammavādino pāveyyakā bhikkhūti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.6.16: apicāhaṃ na tāva diṭṭhiṃ āvīkaromi appeva nāma maṃ imasmiṃ adhikaraṇe sammanneyyāti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.6.17: mayhampi kho āvuso dhammañca vinayañca paccavekkhantassa evaṃ hoti:
pli-tv-kd22:2.6.18: adhammavādino pācīnakā bhikkhū dhammavādino pāveyyakā bhikkhūti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.6.19: apicāhaṃ na tāva diṭṭhiṃ āvīkaromi appevanāma maṃ imasmiṃ adhikaraṇe sammanneyyāti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.7.1: atha kho saṅgho taṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vinicchinitukāmo sannipati.
pli-tv-kd22:2.7.2: tasmiṃ kho pana adhikaraṇe vinicchiyamāne anaggāni ceva bhassāni jāyanti. na cekassa bhāsitassa attho viññāyati.
pli-tv-kd22:2.7.3: atha kho āyasmā revato saṅghaṃ ñāpesi:
pli-tv-kd22:2.7.5: amhākaṃ imasmiṃ adhikaraṇe vinicchiyamāne anaggāni ceva bhassāni jāyanti na cekassa bhāsitassa attho viññāyati.
pli-tv-kd22:2.7.6: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ saṅgho imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ ubbāhikāya vūpasameyya.
pli-tv-kd22:2.7.7: saṅgho cattāro pācīnake bhikkhū cattāro pāveyyake bhikkhū uccini.
pli-tv-kd22:2.7.9: āyasmantañca sabbakāmiṃ āyasmantañca sāḷhaṃ āyasmantañca khujjasobhitaṃ āyasmantañca vāsabhagāmikaṃ.
pli-tv-kd22:2.7.11: āyasmantañca revataṃ. āyasmantañca sambhūtaṃ sāṇavāsiṃ. āyasmantañca yasaṃ kākaṇḍakaputtaṃ. āyasmantañca sumanaṃ.
pli-tv-kd22:2.7.12: atha kho āyasmā revato saṅghaṃ ñāpesi:
pli-tv-kd22:2.7.14: amhākaṃ imasmiṃ adhikaraṇe vinicchiyamāne anaggāni ceva bhassāni jāyanti na cekassa bhāsitassa attho viññāyati.
pli-tv-kd22:2.7.15: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ saṅgho cattāro pācīnake bhikkhū cattāro pāveyyake bhikkhū sammanneyya ubbāhikāya imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasametuṃ.
pli-tv-kd22:2.7.18: amhākaṃ imasmiṃ adhikaraṇe vinicchiyamāne anaggāni ceva bhassāni jāyanti na cekassa bhāsitassa attho viññāyati.
pli-tv-kd22:2.7.19: saṅgho cattāro pācīnake bhikkhū cattāro pāveyyake bhikkhū sammannati ubbāhikāya imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasametuṃ.
pli-tv-kd22:2.7.20: yassāyasmato khamati catuṇṇaṃ pācīnakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ catuṇṇaṃ pāveyyakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ sammuti ubbāhikāya imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasametuṃ. so tuṇhassa.
pli-tv-kd22:2.7.22: sammatā saṅghena cattāro pācīnakā bhikkhū cattāro pāveyyakā bhikkhū ubbāhikāya imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasametuṃ.
pli-tv-kd22:2.7.23: khamati saṅghassa tasmā tuṇhī evametaṃ dhārayāmīti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.7.24: tena kho pana samayena ajito nāma bhikkhu dasavasso saṅghassa pātimokkhuddesako hoti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.7.25: atha kho saṅgho āyasmantampi ajitaṃ sammannati
pli-tv-kd22:2.7.28: kattha nu kho mayaṃ imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasameyyāmāti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.7.30: ayaṃ kho vālikārāmo ramaṇīyo appasaddo appanigghoso.
pli-tv-kd22:2.7.31: yannūna mayaṃ vālikārāme imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasameyyāmāti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.7.32: atha kho therā bhikkhū vālikārāmaṃ agamaṃsu
pli-tv-kd22:2.8.1: atha kho āyasmā revato saṅghaṃ ñāpesi:
pli-tv-kd22:2.8.3: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ ahaṃ āyasmantaṃ sabbakāmiṃ vinayaṃ puccheyyanti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.8.6: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ ahaṃ revatena vinayaṃ puṭṭho vissajjeyyanti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.8.7: atha kho āyasmā revato āyasmantaṃ sabbakāmiṃ etadavoca.
pli-tv-kd22:2.8.23: kappati bhante dvaṅgulāya chāyāya vītivattāya vikāle bhojanaṃ bhuñjitunti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.8.35: kappati bhante idāni gāmantaraṃ gamissāmīti bhuttāvinā pavāritena anatirittaṃ bhojanaṃ bhuñjitunti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.8.47: kappati bhante sambahulā āvāsā samānasīmā nānuposathaṃ kātunti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.8.59: kappati bhante vaggena saṅghena kammaṃ kātuṃ
pli-tv-kd22:2.8.73: idaṃ me upajjhāyena ajjhāciṇṇaṃ idaṃ me ācariyena ajjhāciṇṇaṃ
pli-tv-kd22:2.8.75: āciṇṇakappo kho āvuso ekacco kappati ekacco na kappatīti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.8.82: kappati bhante yaṃ taṃ khīraṃ khīrabhāvaṃ vijahitaṃ asampattaṃ dadhibhāvaṃ, taṃ bhuttāvinā pavāritena anatirittaṃ pātunti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.8.94: kappati bhante yā sā surā āsutā asampattā majjabhāvaṃ, sā pātunti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.8.127: nihatametaṃ āvuso adhikaraṇaṃ santaṃ vūpasantaṃ suvūpasantaṃ.
pli-tv-kd22:2.8.128: api ca maṃ tvaṃ āvuso saṅghamajjhepi imāni dasavatthūni puccheyyāsi tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ saññattiyāti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.8.129: atha kho āyasmā revato āyasmantaṃ sabbakāmiṃ saṅghamajjhepi imāni dasavatthūni pucchi.
pli-tv-kd22:2.9.1: imāya kho pana vinayasaṅgītiyā satta bhikkhusatāni anūnāni anadhikāni ahesuṃ. tasmāyaṃ vinayasaṅgīti sattasatikāti vuccatīti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.9.16: kammaṃ ca parivāso ca samuccayo samathopi ca khuddaṃ senāsanaṃ bhedā vattūposathe bhikkhunī pañcasati sattasatī khandhakā cullavaggamhi [vuttā dvādasamā siyuṃ] cullavaggo niṭṭhito.
